import pytest

class TestAlarms:
    def test_proximal_tube_connected(self, mock_sensor):
        mock_sensor.is_proximal_tube_connected.return_value = True
        assert not controller.report_proximal_tube_connected()

    def test_proximal_tube_disconnected_alarm(self, mock_sensor, mock_gui):
        mock_sensor.is_proximal_tube_connected.return_value = False
        gui.compute_alarm("proximal tube disconnect", priority=MEDIUM)
        assert mock_gui.alarm_active("proximal tube disconnect")

    def test_obstruction_alarm(self, mock_sensor, mock_gui):
        mock_sensor.get_vti.return_value = 50
        gui.compute_alarm("obstruction", priority=HIGH)
        assert mock_gui.alarm_active("obstruction")

    def test_obstruction_alarm_inactivated(self, mock_sensor, mock_gui):
        mock_sensor.get_vti.return_value = 150
        assert not mock_gui.alarm_active("obstruction")

    def test_leakage_calculation(self, mock_sensor):
        mock_sensor.get_leakage.return_value = 2.5
        assert gui.compute_leakage() == 2.5
